summary: Iteration 4 backend-only test of forgot-password Resend-sandbox fallback. Created 19 pytest cases covering all requested scenarios: admin1 delivered=true, admin2/new-member delivered=false with plaintext OTP stored, no enumeration leak for unknown email, admin-only /admin/pending-otps shape (no otp_hash, includes email/user_name/user_role/otp_plain/delivery_error/expires_at/created_at) with 401/403 auth guards, end-to-end reset for failed-delivery member using plaintext OTP, wrong OTP 400, OTP marked used after reset, /admin/otps/{email}/resend 200 (delivered=false) and 404 for missing, plus regressions (brute-force 429, /admin/stats keys, /public/events, /me for both admins). All 19 tests passed on the public URL. Admin1/Admin2 passwords verified still Admin@123 after tests and test member was deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1323 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, members, events, admin, gallery) for maintainability.

forgot-password stores otp_plain in Mongo. Acceptable as temporary workaround, but plaintext OTP at rest is a security tradeoff. Add a TTL index on password_reset_otps.expires_at so plaintext is auto-purged, and ensure admin_pending_otps entries are audit-logged when viewed.
admin_resend_otp returns delivery error string verbatim (truncated 400 chars). Fine, but consider not exposing raw provider error messages to admins in the response — could leak API-key hints.
No index on password_reset_otps.email — repeated forgot-password flows will do full scans as collection grows. Add unique index on email.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 verified forgot-password Resend fallback end-to-end. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_forgot_password.py is idempotent (uses unique test-member email per run, cleans up on completion). Admin1 is the only email that Resend actually delivers to in sandbox — this is asserted as delivered=true and is treated as correct behavior. If Resend domain gets verified later, test_04/05/14 will start returning delivered=true and will need to be updated to accept either outcome.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Resend account is in sandbox without a verified domain, so all sends to addresses other than the account owner (mchanakya64@gmail.com) silently fail. Fix (verified working): forgot_password now captures send_result.ok and, on failure, persists otp_plain + delivery_status='failed' + delivery_error in password_reset_otps. New admin endpoints GET /admin/pending-otps and POST /admin/otps/{email}/resend let admins hand the code over out-of-band. verify-otp/reset-password paths unchanged and confirmed working with the plaintext OTP retrieved from pending-otps.
